properties.description:
The home page, rewritten 2026-10-12, in this order:
- "You decide. The AI helps. reflow2 remembers why."
- What it is and isn't, including that reflow2 runs no AI, doesn't replace people or their conversations, and isn't needed for one-afternoon jobs.
- The three partners, each with what it brings and can't be trusted with.
- The five decision steps (notice, look into it, weigh the options, decide, learn), each with what goes wrong and what reflow2 does.
- What the record keeps.
- A pointer to walkthrough.html.
- The hub as the next step.
It uses the made-up Gearheads, and "project brain" names only a hub. The footer says which release it was checked against.

2026-10-13 (chg:the-home-page-says-what-the-links-answer-and-shows-them-adding-up-2026-10-13): the opening line and "It is" call the record connected, and a new "It isn't" item says it is not just a place to write things down. "What the record keeps" adds what the links let it answer. A new section, "It adds up", charts reflow2's own design from counts.json, which is generated at publish and never typed.
properties.name: site/index.html — what reflow2 is and isn't: a partnership, told along the five decision steps
